evidence_quotes: Combined data from both sexes showed a 9.6% increase in median lifespan in P4-P30 rapamycin-treated mice compared with control mice (treated with ethanol vehicle).

Absolute median lifespan values (in days, derived from Kaplan-Meier curves): - Control (combined sexes), n = 23: median lifespan = 856 days - Rapamycin P4-P30 (combined sexes), n = 23: median lifespan = 938 days
treatment with the mTORC1 inhibitor rapamycin increased lifespan of Bmal1−/− mice by 50%.
The median lifespan of untreated mice is 7.8 months and median lifespan of the Rapatar-treated mice is 11.5 months, thus the treatment increased the median lifespan by 50%.
31 Bmal1−/− mice (both genders) were treated with rapatar and 73 Bmal1−/− mice (both genders) treated with control solution were used for the longevity experiment.
